summary: The root نَسَفَ (nasafa) primarily describes the action of wind carrying something away, like dust. It implies scattering or dispersing something lightly, similar to how wind blows things away.
lane: 1 نَسَفَتْهُ الرِّيحُ ذ , (Mgh, Msb, TA,) aor. نَسِفَ , (TA,) inf. n. نَسْفٌ ; (Msb, TA;) and , (TA,) The wind carried it away; (TA;) i. q. ذَرَتْهُ [q. v.]; (Mgh;) namely, dust. (Mgh, Msb.)
